title: James Comey, one of Trump’s most frequent targets, indicted by prosecutor installed by president – live
summary: Former FBI director indicted on one count of making a false statement to Congress and one count of obstruction of justice Full story – James Comey indicted by federal grand jury on two charges Dozens of House Democrats have signed a letter to Donald Trump and secretary of state Marco Rubio , urging the administration to recognize Palestinian statehood. The letter, led by California Democrat Ro Khanna, has 46 signatures, and lawmakers will send it to the US president on Friday, according to plans first provided to the Guardian . Continue reading...

title: FBI Director James Comey indicted on criminal charges stemming from 2020 testimony
summary: Comey faces one count of making false statements and one count of obstruction of justice in connection.

title: Hollywood now has dueling open letters over the Israel film boycott
summary: Over 1,200 Hollywood figures, among them Liev Schreiber, Mayim Bialik and Sharon Osbourne, signed a letter on Thursday rejecting a previous call to boycott Israeli film groups.

title: Amazon to pay $2.5 billion to settle U.S. lawsuit that it 'tricked' people into Prime
summary: Federal regulators say Amazon has agreed to pay a historic sum to resolve their allegations that its web designs manipulated millions of people into paying for Prime subscriptions, which were also purposefully hard to cancel. Affected shoppers are slated to receive payouts.
